topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: I've been hearing the clinking of metal and the thud of posts being driven into the ground. Our neighbor is installing a fence, a stark line that wasn’t there before. Every new section seems to stretch the silence between our homes a little further. The garden, once shared by our wandering eyes and careless laughter, now feels a bit colder, a bit more enclosed. I notice less the flowers blooming on the other side, and more the shadows cast by the rising barrier. It’s a change I didn’t see coming, one that reshapes the space where our lives used to spill over so easily into each other’s.
